actions.type: 霧散後才浮現的漂流群島，島民用風箏把貨物送到鄰島，每天傍晚要點燈替迷路的風箏引路。

actions.eval: (async()=>{for(let i=0;i<1200;i++){if(document.querySelectorAll("[data-card]").length===7){return {worldMs:Date.now()-window.__e2e.t0};} const e=document.body.innerText.match(/錯誤 · [\w.-]+/); if(e) return {error:e[0]}; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250));} return "timeout";})()

actions.type: 更溫暖一點，提到傍晚的燈。

actions.eval: (async()=>{for(let i=0;i<600;i++){const now=document.querySelectorAll("[data-card]")[1].querySelector("textarea,input").value; const busy=[...document.querySelectorAll("button")].some(b=>b.innerText.trim()==="取消"||b.innerText.includes("停止")); if(now!==window.__e2e.before&&!busy) return {ms:Date.now()-window.__e2e.r0, now}; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250));} return "timeout";})()

(async()=>{for(let i=0;i<900;i++){const t=document.body.innerText; if(!t.includes("正在撰寫故事與章節")) return {ms:Date.now()-window.__e2e.l0, error:(t.match(/錯誤 · [\w.-]+/)||[null])[0]}; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250));} return "timeout";})()

(async()=>{for(let i=0;i<600;i++){const busy=[...document.querySelectorAll("button")].some(b=>b.innerText.trim()==="取消"||b.innerText.includes("停止")); const now=window.__e2e.snap(); if(!busy&&now!==window.__e2e.c0) return {ms:Date.now()-window.__e2e.w0}; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250));} return "timeout";})()

(async()=>{for(let i=0;i<1200;i++){const t=document.body.innerText; if(t.includes("進入世界")) return {builtMs:Date.now()-window.__e2e.b0}; const e=t.match(/錯誤 · [\w.-]+/); if(e) return {error:e[0]}; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250));} return "timeout";})()
